version_notes: v1.1.2 (2026-10-19): gate fix - verify_no_fabrication.py: two kinds of reformat noise. (1) A word already in the source was flagged as a new proper noun when a reformat moved it mid-line or capitalized it (one-per-line competencies joined with " | ": Budgeting, Sales, Team). Proposed proper nouns are now compared case-insensitively against every word of the source, wherever it sits. (2) A unit letter (k, M, b) took the first letter of the next word, even across a line break ("20 Mechanics" -> "20 M"), so a rewrapped line changed the token and an old number was flagged as new; the context snippet then came from the first substring match, so "20" showed the context of "200+". Units now count only when no letter follows, and context is taken from a whole-token match. "200+" was already one token. New tools, employers and numbers still flag. Found by the owner's Mode A run (2026-10-19). v1.1.1 (2026-10-18): gate fix - verify_no_fabrication.py: a comma right after a number ("In 2023, four new") was kept as part of the token, so a number or year already in the source was flagged as new ("2023,", "40,"). Trailing commas are now stripped; inner commas ("1,200") are kept and truly new numbers are still flagged. Found by the first live outcome-eval run of interview-prep (2026-10-18). v1.1.0 (2026-10-18) adds the fresh-context drafter-reviewer pass (Mode B step 5): review_pass.py builds a reviewer packet with the posting fenced as untrusted, and checks the reviewer's JSON findings so a quote counts only where it really appears; a posting requirement without a verified source fact becomes a user question, never an edit. Advisory only; verify_no_fabrication stays mandatory and runs last. Ships byte-identical in cover-letter. v1.0.0 is the job-hunter family resume-tailor member, carved from the v5.2.0 monolith's Phase 3 (Tailor Application Materials). THE MOST SAFETY-CRITICAL member: it carries the anti-fabrication HARD GATE. Owns verify_no_fabrication.py (the detection-only fabrication gate, guarded by 5 load-bearing safety tests listed above) plus extract_ats_keywords.py (eval-only, the three-category ATS keyword-gap analysis). Splits Mode A (Tighten/Copyedit, zero-fabrication contract) from Mode B (Tailor for a specific posting, with the mandatory verify_no_fabrication gate). Reads original resume + JD; produces a gated Resume_[Company]_[Role].docx per the family workspace-contract only after every new claim has explicit per-claim user confirmation. The script NEVER auto-approves; auto_approved is always False.
